source.name: Sportico - Thanks LeBron: 76ers Sign One of NBA's Richest Jersey Patch Deals
source.quote: Crypto.com was the team’s patch partner for the previous five years, and the team and firm mutually agreed to end it a year early.

note: Jersey patch, ended a year early when Bloom Energy took over for 2026-27. Front Office Sports reported in 2026 that it was a six-year deal announced in 2021 worth more than $10 million a year (frontofficesports.com, 2026-07-30).
